O.content: The orange slice carrying the Nuclear inscription visibly spans a larger angular area than the red Hydroelectric, pale-yellow Fossil Fuels, and light-orange Renewables slices.
The title visibly reads "Global Energy Consumption by Source".

B.text: If the pie encodes consumption shares by slice area and slice labels attach to their respective slices, the visibly largest slice identifies the largest category; the routing criterion then requires that category's priority-monitoring option when available.
B.conditions: Assumes slice areas are proportionally encoded and the Nuclear option routes the Nuclear slice.

B.text: If the pie-slice labels state each source's share of the global energy consumption measure named in the chart title, the category with the greatest labeled share is the largest consumption category; the routing criterion requires selecting that category's priority-monitoring option when available.
B.conditions: Assumes the printed percentages are the chart's intended comparable consumption shares and the Nuclear escalation option routes Nuclear.
